content: Store this medication at room temperature, ensuring it is kept away from light and moisture. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. When the product is expired or no longer needed, dispose of it properly according to local regulations. If you miss a dose of this medication and are taking it to prevent infection before a scheduled surgery, take the missed dose as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, continue with your regular dosing schedule and consult your doctor or pharmacist immediately for guidance on a new dosing schedule. If you are taking this medication to treat hepatic encephalopathy and miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and take the next dose at the regular time. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Laboratory and/or medical tests, such as hearing tests or kidney function tests, may be conducted while you are taking this medication.
